title: Acylindrical hyperbolicity of automorphism groups and property $R_\infty$ for generalized Higman groups
summary: We consider the Higman groups $H_k$ ($k\ge 4$) and their generalizations studied by Martin and Horbez--Huang. We prove that the automorphism groups of the Horbez--Huang groups on at least five generators, as well as those of Martin's $4$-generated Higman-like groups, are acylindrically hyperbolic. It follows that the groups themselves are acylindrically hyperbolic, admit infinite-dimensional spaces of automorphism-invariant homogeneous quasimorphisms, have infinite $2$-generated simple characteristic quotients, and satisfy property $R_\infty$.
